qs.q: Which imaging modality is primarily utilized to detect chondrocalcinosis or periarticular entheses calcification when screening for crystal arthropathies?
qs.e: Plain radiographs are used to show chondrocalcification, periarticular entheses calcification, or tendon calcification in crystal arthropathies. Other imaging modalities like CT or MRI are secondary adjuncts.
